_note: CPI-U relative importance (% of All items), U.S. city average, copied from the 'Relative importance' column of BLS CPI news release Table 2 (https://www.bls.gov/news.release/cpi.t02.htm). That column is the previous month's relative importance, which is the correct weight for the current month's change. Update as_of + weights after each CPI release. Derived rows (e.g. SUPERCORE) take base weight minus the excluded items. anchors = extra relative-importance snapshots (BLS annual December table) used to back/forward-cast monthly weights for history: RI_m = RI_anchor x (I_m / I_anchor) / (AllItems_m / AllItems_anchor), NSA indexes.
